findings.fix: Light texture that spreads easily, with no visible white cast on application.
findings.why: An unqualified 'no white cast' reads as an absolute for everyone. The page scopes it to application.

language_read: SPF and PA claims match the page, and price and MRP are shown with the pack size. 'No white cast' is the one unscoped phrase.
tone_read: Plain, factual offer ad with no urgency, fear or hype. The free-offer condition and T&C are stated in the creative.
